Episode 219. The Power of Kinzelo
January 4, 1804.

Two days have passed since the end of the first Great War. However, transition cracks continue to form throughout Inse, and each faction was engaged in daily battles with the demons of the demon world while removing these.
And this morning, Orgal arrived at Tikan with Grenil and about three hundred warships.
"I thought you came to start a war, Orgal."
Jin pointed to the fleet that filled the sky beyond the front and said.
[A war in this crisis? That's a dull joke.]
The reason Orgal brought the fleet was none other than.
Barrier.
It was to join the barrier that the Vamel Federation was forming at sea centering on the Golden Ship.
-[Even if we do not form a temporary alliance, we will not spare any kind of support if needed when the Vamel Federation fights the underground.]
-Without any compensation?
-[Yes. Whether it's information about the underground or military forces. We will support everything.]
Jin recalled the conversation he had with Orgal a few days ago.

"I don't remember asking for support first. Just saying it would be helpful to the barrier when you came... Kinzelo, it's better than I thought these days? I heard that you were having quite a hard time clearing the cracks."
[We brought the fleet because it's livable. Don't show off unnecessarily.]
"I'm just saying because I'm grateful but worried."
In the end, the biggest enemy is Zipple, then Kinzelo.

The war with the underground forces cannot be avoided and has already begun. Therefore, for the Vamel Federation, it was the best result for the underground forces to annihilate with other enemies, or to give them the greatest blow and disappear.

'Did any of the especially strong demons that Kinzelo possesses join the mainland? Or is it another factor... Kinzelo still seems to have some power left. For now, there isn't much room to investigate why Kinzelo regained his leisure. My mind is filled with the demon world.'
It's not that he wasn't expecting it at all. To Jin's view, much of Kinzelo had been revealed, but it was still a huge monster group shrouded in a veil.
"How did you know that I was trying to build a barrier at sea?"
"The only way to minimize civilian damage is that, so I thought you would naturally build a barrier. Moreover, we Kinzelo also need a barrier."
"So there are times when you guys worry about the lives of ordinary people."
[Not all of us, beastmen and demons, are combatants. Any group will be destroyed if it loses its territory and people. Are we any different?]
Jin nodded his head.

"So since the time you were known as a third-rate terror group, you must have worked hard to scrape together your members. Okay, I accept it. Discuss the fleet deployment with the executives on the barrier side."
[Alright. Anyway, you've caused quite a commotion from the start. I didn't expect you to go straight to the main base.]
"I was curious about that demon named Phaelito Belgashium."
[If he hadn't been there, both of you could have returned without any major injuries. Ah, Murakan should rest for a while though.]
"You seem to know a lot."
[I remember Murakan's full heyday. Sakiel didn't even get hurt using Zito's flesh, so he must have forced himself to recreate that time. It's not a big weakness compared to what I've spit out.]
"Ah, so that black mass was Zito's flesh. I suspected it was something closely related to Zito."
[Sakiel consumed the flesh, so Zito has permanently lost that much power. It's only a drop in the bucket, but it will become significant if it piles up. Aura has already slightly weakened Zito.]
Orgal added that it was important to weaken Zito as much as possible in this way before Zito appeared in Inse.

[A complete Zito is invincible. Even if he regains about 80% of his power, it will be the same. From 50%, there is a possibility for the forces on the ground. So it would be good to protect the Eye of Zito that the Holy Kingdom has while consuming as much of the flesh that he distributed to the top demons.]
"How much do you think one piece of flesh will contribute to Zito's power?"
[It will vary in size. The one you guys got rid of this time is probably about 1 penny.]
Jin looked back at the past battle with Sakiel.

‘This time Sakiel inevitably used his flesh for defense, but if he had used it for attack... very few people could withstand it. Still, it's confirmed that Zito has permanently weakened, so it's worth getting rid of.'
From the beginning, the purpose of Aura forcing the manifestation was to give Zito an 'irreversible injury', so Aura also had the same opinion about the core of the Zito strategy as Orgal.
"It's not 10% but 1 penny, but it seems I've made a decent income."
"Alright. But if you plan to raid the naval base again in the future, I'd like to discourage you."
"Why is that?"

[The Demon Kings of the Demon World have been summoned to the naval base. There are about five to ten, each of them surpassing Sakiel Grosh. They will all have Zito's flesh, so no matter how capable you and Murakan are, coming back unscathed would be too much.]

Charging in to eliminate all the flesh at once is madness. If multiple pieces of flesh are used at the same time, even the top superhumans should be prepared for death, and the combat power of the Demon Kings is also an issue. The basic tactic for 'permanent damage' to Zito was to isolate and eliminate.
"Good information."
[Shall I give you one more good piece of information?]
"I'm all ears."
[Elona Zipple. She is currently severely injured.]
"......What did you say?"
Jin's eyes widened. After the Great War began, the spies that the Alliance had planted in the Federation were unable to gather proper information.

Zipple was also too busy dealing with the cracks formed throughout the Federation, making it difficult to approach. Among them, Elona Zipple was a particularly difficult target to gather information on.

[Ragal Fun. A character known in the Demon World as the King of Poison, Ragal of the Poison, Born of Poison, etc. It seems he has recently been promoted from a great general to a Demon King, and she fell to him.]
"Does this Ragal have a combat power of a level comparable to Genesis?"
[No, of course, he's strong, but not to that extent.]
"But then how...... Ah, poison. Does he have a special poison that can threaten even the Genesis?"

[His poison did work, so I guess you could say that. Elona Zipple was injured while blocking the poison that Ragal had spread widely for mass slaughter. In other words, he used hostages to hurt Elona.]
"Elona Zipple, she protected hostages......?"

[Just because Elona Zipple is injured, it doesn't mean you can attack Zipple right now, but I thought it would be good to let you know about the existence of Ragal Fun. Also the fact that even Elona Zipple has weaknesses.]
To Jin, fighting while protecting hostages was not the way of a 'broken Veradin'.

-The records left by Elona Zipple are quite hopeful. As soon as she woke up, Elona had a consciousness to avoid killing as much as possible, and experienced confusion about the purpose of her existence.

-Above all, what is strange is that until now, the history of Elona Zipple had been erased. The main culprits who manipulated the history would surely be Zipple, so perhaps Elona might have been their victim. Because there is no way they would erase the history of the grand wizard of a proud family until now.
These were the words Valeria said while examining the records after Elona woke from the seal of Hidden Palace.
'As I guessed then, is Elona not fully controlled by Zipple? If so... Elona could potentially still be an ally, not an enemy. Perhaps she could be the key to bringing Veradin back.'
Veradin, something bitter rose within him as he thought of his friend. Whether it was the Demon World or the Human World, if the war continued, he would eventually have to face him.
He wanted nothing more than to somehow bring him back to his old self before that day came.
'Anyway, Orgal is providing several pieces of high-quality information.'
But there was something strange.
'But how did Orgal get this information? Even the Owl Knights and Sister Yona had no access to Elona.'
Jin met Orgal's eyes.
"How did you find out? This doesn't seem like speculation like the barrier or Murakan's situation, but something you can't know without direct observation."

[I came here to provide information that would be helpful to us if you knew it, not to reveal everything. Well, I must be going. I still don't have any updated information on Lokia Ganesto, so we'll talk later.]
As Orgal left, Jin fell into thought for a moment. It felt like he had gotten a glimpse of Kinzelo's power after a long time.
"...... After recently getting beaten up by the Demon Tribes and showing a crumbling figure in the Demon World. I should be on guard, those Kinzelo bastards."
"It seems he found out about Elona through something other than a deal, my lord."

"I think so too. Considering the leisure that has arisen in the Demon World's invasion... let's find out what they're up to. Jett, contact the Nameless and ask them to dispatch Sister Yona to Kinzelo. We can't break through to Elona anyway, so it would be better to keep an eye on Kinzelo."
"Yes, my lord!"
"One thing's for sure, there's something in Kinzelo right now that they don't want the Demon World to see."
At Jin's words, his comrades tilted their heads.
"Something they don't want to be seen?"
"Yes, so they're trying to stir our barrier on purpose. Let's wait for Sister Yona to find out what that is. And the rest of us should be doing our best to deplete Zito's flesh."
How to deplete Zito's flesh as much as possible.
The method, of course, would be a 'preemptive strike'.

"It's always annoying to sit back and rush out to block their rifts. I will allocate some of the top combat personnel, who are currently focused on clearing rifts, to strike at the completed castles of the Demon World."
